question.text: An AIF trust's governance structure is defined primarily in:

explanation.text: The Logic: When an AIF is constituted as a trust, the trust indenture (trust deed) is the constitutional document that brings the trust into existence and serves as the instrument of trusteeship. The Trap: Detailed governance terms relevant to investors — such as distribution mechanics or specific investor rights — are typically disclosed through the PPM and subscription documents rather than only by reference to the trust deed. Note: SEBI regulations set the overarching minimum standards, while the trust deed is the foundational charter of the trust itself.
